_comment: HTTP 403 Forbidden from PUT /v2/workouts/plan/{id}. The commonest cause is a BASIC (non-premium) athlete: TrainingPeaks does not let basic accounts create or modify future planned workouts. 403 can also mean the athlete is disconnected. The JSON envelope shown is illustrative.

_body_illustrative.error_description: Basic athletes cannot modify future planned workouts

_notes: Detect premium status via GET /v1/athlete/profile -> IsPremium. IsPremium is false for basic accounts and excludes trial subscriptions. Premium-only fields return null on read and are ignored on write.
